name: Supplier Qualification Pipeline
description: End-to-end workflow for qualifying suppliers for OEM requirements. Covers requirement capture, supplier research, RFQ management, response tracking, audits, and final selection.

stages.name: Capture OEM Requirements
stages.description: Document OEM specifications including tolerances, volumes, certifications, and timeline

stages.name: Identify Suppliers
stages.description: Research suppliers with relevant capabilities (machining, material expertise, certifications)

stages.name: Send RFQs
stages.description: Generate and send RFQ emails to shortlisted suppliers

stages.name: Track Responses
stages.description: Log supplier responses, quotes, and capabilities. Score each supplier.

stages.name: Schedule Audits
stages.description: Coordinate site audits, manage stakeholder communications, track qualification tasks

stages.name: Final Supplier Selection
stages.description: Compare qualified suppliers and make final recommendation to client
